api_tokens_workspace_id_ck.name: api_tokens_workspace_id_ck
api_tokens_workspace_id_ck.value: ("api_tokens"."kind"::text <> 'api' or "api_tokens"."workspace_id" is not null) and ("api_tokens"."kind"::text in ('job', 'api') or "api_tokens"."workspace_id" is null)

channels_status_secret_ck.name: channels_status_secret_ck
channels_status_secret_ck.value: case "channels"."status"::text when 'active' then "channels"."secret_ciphertext" is not null when 'disconnected' then "channels"."secret_ciphertext" is null else true end

kb_entries_workspace_id_dedupe_key_uq.name: kb_entries_workspace_id_dedupe_key_uq
kb_entries_workspace_id_dedupe_key_uq.where: "kb_entries"."dedupe_key" is not null and "kb_entries"."deleted_at" is null

post_metrics_counts_ck.name: post_metrics_counts_ck
post_metrics_counts_ck.value: coalesce("post_metrics"."views", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."likes", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."comments", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."shares", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."saves", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."reach", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("post_metrics"."avg_watch_ms", 0) >= 0

oauth_connections_candidates_ck.name: oauth_connections_candidates_ck
oauth_connections_candidates_ck.value: case when jsonb_typeof("oauth_connections"."candidates") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("oauth_connections"."candidates") <= 100 else false end

scheduled_posts_version_ck.name: scheduled_posts_version_ck
scheduled_posts_version_ck.value: "scheduled_posts"."status"::text not in ('queued', 'publishing', 'published') or "scheduled_posts"."version_id" is not null

scheduled_tasks_lease_ck.name: scheduled_tasks_lease_ck
scheduled_tasks_lease_ck.value: "scheduled_tasks"."status"::text <> 'running' or ("scheduled_tasks"."locked_by" is not null and "scheduled_tasks"."locked_until" is not null)
